entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A dangerous world that protects its own power, where explorers must be well geared.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Nomadic Zendikari whose culture is founded on interconnectedness and relies on hooks, ropes and lines.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Zendikari with streamlined coral-like armor and a highly developed pictorial written language.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Zendikari race of elegance and brutality, wearing beetle-carapace armor and wielding fanglike double blades.

entities.name: Nulls
entities.description: Mindless monsters created by lesser vampires.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Poorly prepared but numerous explorers on Zendikar.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Zendikari climbers who build in trees and wear drab natural garb.

entities.name: Mul Daya
entities.description: Elf nation with ghost-white facepaint and fiery red-dyed hair.

entities.name: Hagra Cistern
entities.description: A dread site in Guul Draz reached by a deadly route.

entities.name: Eternity Vessel
entities.description: A renowned treasure whose location was last whispered with a dying breath.

entities.name: Kabira Crossroads
entities.description: Site of a flophouse for explorers.

entities.name: Pathway stones
entities.description: Small rune-etched stone cubes chipped from ancient hedrons, used by mages and goblin guides.

relations.quote: The one exception is the Mul Daya nation
nulls, the mindless monsters created by lesser vampires
